llm.summary: This skill is high-permission TikTok account automation, but its access, limits, data handling, and stop conditions are clearly disclosed and aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: It requires a logged-in TikTok browser profile and macOS Accessibility control, which is powerful, but the artifact prominently discloses that authority and recommends deliberate grants and a dedicated low-privilege user session.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown only and ships no executable code; setup requires user-provided tools such as openclaw and cliclick plus local workspace initialization.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are tightly scoped with role separation, quotas, phase gates, qualification checks, honest automation disclosure, and mandatory stop conditions for captcha, rate limits, warnings, bans, and posting mistakes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Local persistence is limited to named memory files with bounded retention for usernames and counts; optional webhook egress is off by default but can send operational recaps with account and lead identifiers if configured.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly for operating one owned TikTok Business account by replying to inbound DMs and comments, with outbound prospecting and anti-abuse bypasses out of scope.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable granting a terminal Accessibility control and using a logged-in TikTok profile for scheduled account actions. Keep the webhook unset unless operators need it, use a dedicated low-privilege browser/session, monitor the local logs, and stop using the skill if TikTok presents any challenge or account warning.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector:none] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found the sensitive behaviors are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
[AIG:none] expected: The supplied SARIF contained no results; manual review found no embedded code, remote payload execution, persistence backdoors, tool hijacking, or credential exfiltration instructions.
